Inspect packages/blocks/src/research/summarizer.ts and packages/blocks/src/research/summarizer.test.ts:
1. Verify that `parallelMap` executes concurrent requests properly using the worker pool (concurrency default 4).
2. Ensure that if `ctx.llm` is provided, it calls `generateObject` in parallel for each record.
3. Verify that all 12 BMW feedback headers are present in `row.fields`:
   - ID
   - Source
   - Brand
   - Sales Description
   - Country
   - Derivate (e-code)
   - Engine Type
   - Feedback Type
   - Customer Feedback
   - Vfc level2 3 Name
   - Vfc level2 Name
   - Vfc level3 Name
4. Ensure error handling is robust: if one LLM call fails, it falls back to `offlineSummarizeRecord` for that record without failing the whole batch, logging a notice.
5. Run `npm test packages/blocks/src/research/summarizer.test.ts` to ensure all tests pass.
Report back with confirmation.

69: /** Rule-based offline fallback for tests and offline mock mode. */
70: export function offlineSummarizeRecord(
71:   record: ResearchRecord,
72:   source: Source | undefined,
73:   scope: ProductScope,
74: ): SummarizedFeedbackItem {
75:   const text = record.text.trim();
76:   const lower = text.toLowerCase();
77:   const vehicle = scope.vehicleLine || scope.vehicleCode || "1 Series";
78:   const derivate = defaultDerivate(vehicle);
79:   const salesDesc = defaultSalesDescription(vehicle);
80:   const country =
81:     typeof record.fields?.Country === "string"
82:       ? record.fields.Country
83:       : (record.marketAttribution?.value ?? scope.market ?? "EU");
84: 
85:   let feedbackType: SummarizedFeedbackItem["feedbackType"] = "Likes";
86:   if (/\b(defect|broken|fault|error|malfunction|damage|squeak|rattle)\b/i.test(lower)) {
87:     feedbackType = "Defect";
88:   } else if (
89:     /\b(difficult|awkward|distract|hard|complicated|annoy|confusing|frustrat|nightmare)\b/i.test(
90:       lower,
91:     )
92:   ) {
93:     feedbackType = "Difficult to Use";
94:   } else if (/\b(wish|want|need|missing|lack|should have|wants|request)\b/i.test(lower)) {
95:     feedbackType = "Wants";
96:   }
97: 
98:   let vfcLevel2 = "General enquiry: customer feedback";
99:   let vfcLevel3 = "Like: function";
100: 
101:   if (/\b(touchscreen|touch|display|screen|idrive|software|navi|app|os9|os8|infotainment|bluetooth)\b/i.test(lower)) {
102:     vfcLevel2 = "ConnectedDrive and Infotainment, overall technology";
103:     vfcLevel3 =
104:       feedbackType === "Difficult to Use"
105:         ? "Not user-friendly"
106:         : feedbackType === "Defect"
107:           ? "Malfunction"
108:           : feedbackType === "Wants"
109:             ? "Customer request: usability"
110:             : "Like: function";
111:   } else if (/\b(seat|seating|chair|lumbar|sitz)\b/i.test(lower)) {
112:     vfcLevel2 = "Seats";
113:     vfcLevel3 =
114:       feedbackType === "Difficult to Use"
115:         ? "Not user-friendly"
116:         : feedbackType === "Likes"
117:           ? "Likes comfort"
118:           : "Customer request: function";
119:   } else if (/\b(steer|suspension|corner|ride|chassis|fahrwerk|handling|nimble|stability)\b/i.test(lower)) {
120:     vfcLevel2 = "Handling / Riding";
121:     vfcLevel3 = "Like: performance";
122:   } else if (/\b(engine|motor|hybrid|power|drivetrain|gearbox|transmission|mild hybrid|consumption|efficiency)\b/i.test(lower)) {
123:     vfcLevel2 = "Drivetrain";
124:     vfcLevel3 = "Like: performance";
125:   } else if (/\b(brake|braking|bremse)\b/i.test(lower)) {
126:     vfcLevel2 = "Braking";
127:     vfcLevel3 = feedbackType === "Defect" ? "Malfunction" : "Like: function";
128:   } else if (/\b(assist|speed limit|parking|lane|kamera|sensor)\b/i.test(lower)) {
129:     vfcLevel2 = "Driver Assistance Systems";
130:     vfcLevel3 = feedbackType === "Defect" ? "Malfunction" : "Like: function";
131:   } else if (/\b(interior|cabin|materials|plastic|quality|verarbeitung)\b/i.test(lower)) {
132:     vfcLevel2 = "Interior design";
133:     vfcLevel3 = "Look / design appeals";
134:   } else if (/\b(exterior|styling|front|rear|grille|look)\b/i.test(lower)) {
135:     vfcLevel2 = "Exterior design";
136:     vfcLevel3 = "Look / design appeals";
137:   }
138: 
139:   const cleanText = text.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, " ").trim();
140:   const summaryPrefix = source?.publisher || source?.title ? `${source?.publisher || source?.title}: ` : "";
141:   const excerpt = cleanText.slice(0, 350) + (cleanText.length > 350 ? "…" : "");
142:   const summary = `[Summary] ${summaryPrefix}${excerpt}`;
143: 
144:   let engineType: SummarizedFeedbackItem["engineType"] = "ICE";
145:   if (/\b(bev|electric|vollelektrisch|i5|i7|battery|laden|charging)\b/i.test(lower)) {
146:     engineType = "BEV";
147:   } else if (/\b(phev|plug-in|hybrid)\b/i.test(lower)) {
148:     engineType = "PHEV";
149:   }
150: 
151:   return {
152:     brand: "[BMW]",
153:     salesDescription: salesDesc,
154:     country,
155:     derivate,
156:     engineType,
157:     feedbackType,
158:     summary,
159:     vfcLevel2Name: vfcLevel2,
160:     vfcLevel3Name: vfcLevel3,
161:   };
162: }

164: /** Runs work across items with a concurrency cap, settling all or aborting promptly. */
165: export async function parallelMap<T, R>(
166:   items: readonly T[],
167:   concurrency: number,
168:   fn: (item: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
169:   signal: AbortSignal,
170: ): Promise<R[]> {
171:   const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
172:   let next = 0;
173:   async function worker() {
174:     while (next < items.length) {
175:       if (signal.aborted) throw new Error("Operation cancelled.");
176:       const current = next++;
177:       results[current] = await fn(items[current]!, current);
178:     }
179:   }
180:   const workers = Math.max(1, Math.min(concurrency, items.length));
181:   await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workers }, worker));
182:   return results;
183: }
184: 
185: export interface SummarizeOptions {
186:   llm?: LlmClient;
187:   scope: ProductScope;
188:   signal: AbortSignal;
189:   log?: (message: string) => void;
190:   concurrency?: number;
191: }
192: 
193: /**
194:  * Summarizes research records concurrently into BMW feedback rows matching
195:  * BMW's feedback export schema (12 columns: ID, Source, Brand, Sales Description,
196:  * Country, Derivate, Engine Type, Feedback Type, Customer Feedback, Vfc...).
197:  */
198: export async function summarizeResearchDataset(
199:   dataset: ResearchDataset,
200:   options: SummarizeOptions,
201: ): Promise<ResearchTableRow[]> {
202:   const sources = new Map(dataset.sources.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
203:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Math.min(options.concurrency ?? 4, 8));
204:   const rows: ResearchTableRow[] = [];
205: 
206:   const summarizedItems = await parallelMap(
207:     dataset.records,
208:     concurrency,
209:     async (record, index) => {
210:       options.signal.throwIfAborted();
211:       const source = sources.get(record.sourceId);
212: 
213:       // If the record already has full BMW originalFields, retain it directly.
214:       const existing = record.metadata.originalFields as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
215:       if (
216:         existing &&
217:         typeof existing === "object" &&
218:         existing["Customer Feedback"] &&
219:         existing["Vfc level2 Name"]
220:       ) {
221:         return {
222:           record,
223:           source,
224:           items: [
225:             {
226:               brand: String(existing["Brand"] ?? "[BMW]"),
227:               salesDescription: String(existing["Sales Description"] ?? "[BMW 1 Series]"),
228:               country: String(existing["Country"] ?? "EU"),
229:               derivate: String(existing["Derivate (e-code)"] ?? "F70"),
230:               engineType: (existing["Engine Type"] as SummarizedFeedbackItem["engineType"]) ?? "ICE",
231:               feedbackType: (existing["Feedback Type"] as SummarizedFeedbackItem["feedbackType"]) ?? "Likes",
232:               summary: String(existing["Customer Feedback"]),
233:               vfcLevel2Name: String(existing["Vfc level2 Name"]),
234:               vfcLevel3Name: String(existing["Vfc level3 Name"] ?? "Like: function"),
235:             },
236:           ],
237:         };
238:       }
239: 
240:       // Try summarizing via LLM if available and not purely mock/stub
241:       if (options.llm && typeof options.llm.generateObject === "function") {
242:         try {
243:           const prompt = JSON.stringify({
244:             contract: "reqflow.research.summarize@1",
245:             scope: {
246:               vehicleLine: options.scope.vehicleLine,
247:               vehicleCode: options.scope.vehicleCode,
248:               derivative: options.scope.derivative,
249:               market: options.scope.market,
250:             },
251:             source: {
252:               title: source?.title || record.sourceId,
253:               publisher: source?.publisher,
254:               url: source?.uri,
255:               provider: record.provider,
256:             },
257:             content: record.text.slice(0, 16_000),
258:           });
259: 
260:           const result = await options.llm.generateObject({
261:             schema: SourceSummariesResult,
262:             system: SUMMARIZER_SYSTEM,
263:             prompt,
264:             tier: "fast",
265:             signal: options.signal,
266:           });
267: 
268:           if (result && result.object && Array.isArray(result.object.items) && result.object.items.length > 0) {
269:             return { record, source, items: result.object.items };
270:           }
271:         } catch (error) {
272:           if (options.signal.aborted) throw error;
273:           options.log?.(
274:             `Summarizer LLM skipped for record ${record.id} (${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}); using structured rule-based summary.`,
275:           );
276:         }
277:       }
278: 
279:       // Offline rule-based fallback
280:       const offlineItem = offlineSummarizeRecord(record, source, options.scope);
281:       return { record, source, items: [offlineItem] };
282:     },
283:     options.signal,
284:   );
285: 
286:   let seq = 1;
287:   for (const { record, source, items } of summarizedItems) {
288:     const columns = Object.fromEntries(BMW_FEEDBACK_HEADERS.map((key) => [key, null]));
289:     for (const [subIndex, item] of items.entries()) {
290:       const id = items.length > 1 ? `${record.id}_item${subIndex + 1}` : record.id;
291:       const vfcFull = `${item.vfcLevel2Name} : ${item.vfcLevel3Name}`;
292:       const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {
293:         ...columns,
294:         ID: id,
295:         Source: source?.publisher ?? source?.title ?? record.provider,
296:         Brand: item.brand,
297:         "Sales Description": item.salesDescription,
298:         Country: item.country,
299:         "Derivate (e-code)": item.derivate,
300:         "Engine Type": item.engineType,
301:         "Feedback Type": item.feedbackType,
302:         "Customer Feedback": item.summary,
303:         "Vfc level2 3 Name": vfcFull,
304:         "Vfc level2 Name": item.vfcLevel2Name,
305:         "Vfc level3 Name": item.vfcLevel3Name,
306:       };
307: 
308:       const row: ResearchTableRow = {
309:         ...record,
310:         id,
311:         collectedRecordId: record.id,
312:         text: item.summary,
313:         locator: record.locator,
314:         fields,
315:         market: item.country,
316:         metadata: {
317:           ...record.metadata,
318:           originalFields: fields,
319:         },
320:         contentHash: createHash("sha256")
321:           .update(JSON.stringify({ text: item.summary, fields }))
322:           .digest("hex"),
323:       };
324:       rows.push(row);
325:       seq++;
326:     }
327:   }
328: 
329:   return rows;
330: }
</content>
